name: Ravi AO
summary: This EA uses the Ravi AO (Average Oscillator) indicator to generate trading signals based on momentum shifts. It enters long positions when the oscillator crosses above its signal line and short positions when it crosses below. The strategy is a systematic momentum-based approach with configurable parameters for period and signal smoothing.
summary_zh: 该EA使用Ravi AO（平均振荡器）指标基于动量变化生成交易信号。当振荡器上穿信号线时做多，下穿时做空。这是一个系统化的动量策略，可配置周期和信号平滑参数。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心基于Ravi AO振荡器指标，通过计算价格动量的变化来捕捉趋势转折点。入场条件为振荡器值上穿信号线时开多单，下穿信号线时开空单，属于典型的动量跟踪策略。出场条件依赖于反向信号触发平仓，未见到独立的止损止盈逻辑。仓位管理方面，EA允许用户固定手数下单，但没有基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理相对简单，缺乏风险敞口控制和最大回撤限制。整体策略逻辑清晰但风险控制薄弱，依赖动量信号的及时性，在震荡市中可能频繁触发虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ravi AO oscillator indicator, capturing trend turning points by calculating changes in price momentum. Entry conditions are triggered when the oscillator value crosses above the signal line for long positions and below for short positions, representing a typical momentum-following strategy. Exit conditions rely on reverse signals to close positions, with no independent stop-loss or take-profit logic observed. Position sizing allows the user to set a fixed lot size, but there is no dynamic position adjustment based on account balance or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, lacking risk exposure controls and maximum drawdown limits. Overall, the strategy logic is clear but risk control is weak, relying on the timeliness of momentum signals, which may trigger frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和调试
基于动量振荡器，能够捕捉趋势早期转折
参数可配置，用户可根据不同品种和时间框架调整
使用MagicNumber区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
信号线平滑机制减少了虚假信号的产生
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic, easy to understand and debug
Based on momentum oscillator, capable of catching early trend reversals
Configurable parameters allow adjustment for different instruments and timeframes
Uses MagicNumber to distinguish orders, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
Signal line smoothing mechanism reduces the generation of false signals
cons: 缺乏独立的止损止盈逻辑，风险暴露不可控
固定手数下单，没有动态仓位管理机制
在震荡行情中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线内反复开仓
缺少点差过滤，高成本交易环境下盈利能力下降
cons_en: Lacks independent stop-loss and take-profit logic, risk exposure is uncontrollable
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic position management mechanism
Prone to frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No new bar check mechanism, may repeatedly open positions within the same bar
Missing spread filter, profitability decreases in high-cost trading environments
improvements: 增加动态止损止盈机制，可基于ATR或固定点数设置
添加新K线检查逻辑，确保每根K线仅交易一次
引入点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免不利市场条件下交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism, configurable based on ATR or fixed pips
Implement new bar check logic to ensure only one trade per bar
Introduce spread filter and volatility filter to avoid trading under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 没有止损保护，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线内重复开仓导致过度交易
固定手数无仓位控制，在小账户上可能因单笔过大而快速爆仓
震荡市中动量信号频繁翻转，连续亏损风险高
risk_points_en: No stop-loss protection, single trade loss can expand indefinitely
Missing new bar check, may repeatedly open positions within the same bar causing over-trading
Fixed lot size without position control, small accounts may blow up quickly from oversized single trades
Momentum signals frequently flip in ranging markets, high risk of consecutive losses
